Join the protagonist on their epic journey as they explore the vast expanse of space, uncover hidden truths, and discover the secrets of the universe.

Along the way, they will also discover the true meaning of friendship, loyalty, and sacrifice, as they form strong bonds with the people and creatures they meet.

As the stakes grow higher, the protagonist will have to make difficult choices that will determine the fate of entire civilizations. The fate of the cosmos rests in their hands, and the outcome is far from certain.

With its richly detailed world-building, complex characters, and pulse-pounding action sequences, "Stars in My Pocket: Adventures in Space-Time Slip" is a thrilling ride that will keep you guessing until the very end. So buckle up, space traveler, and get ready for the adventure of a lifetime!
